      "kind": "approach",

      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",

      "status_by_id": "rc:4416655464",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Add a similar check for macOS code-signing",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author and achow101 noted the macOS cert is not in the repo",

      "other_replies": ["c:6595044276"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6520673273",

      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Make the script stand-alone so that it can be run locally",
